{"parentUuid":"ef52c1f8-327e-4f26-b59f-64b485fde240","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"03933352-0802-49c2-9adc-c164e080d60c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01YBhQ45SeJ2oGC3hHSL514H","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/usage_report.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"251bb93a-9f15-4855-80f8-c490470b03e5","timestamp":"2026-10-10T18:51:24.491Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/usage_report.py","oldString":"    raise NotImplementedError(\"MP2 Exercise B: implement me with /tdd\")","newString":"    total, previous = 0.0, None\n    for value in series:\n        if value is None:\n            continue\n        if previous is not None and value > previous:\n            total += value - previous\n        previous = value\n    return total","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Turn notes/usage-ledger.csv into a plan-vs-actual budget report.\n\nUsage:\n    uv run python scripts/usage_report.py                 # summary + forecast\n    uv run python scripts/usage_report.py --remaining 4   # 4 tickets still to do\n\nWhy positive deltas: the 5-hour and weekly meters RESET (drop to 0) when their\nwindow rolls over, and the weekly one only ever climbs inside a week. Summing\nonly the increases between consecutive rows measures what you actually spent\nand ignores the resets. That is what spend() does, and it is your exercise.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport csv\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nLEDGER = Path(\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\")\n\n\ndef spend(series: list[float | None]) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Total rise across a meter that can reset to a lower value.\n\n    Sum every increase between consecutive readings; ignore blanks (None) and\n    any drop, which means the window reset.\n\n    >>> spend([10.0, 12.0, 15.0])\n    5.0\n    >>> spend([80.0, 5.0, 9.0])\n    4.0\n    >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])\n    3.0\n    \"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\"MP2 Exercise B: implement me with /tdd\")\n\ndef read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:\n        return list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\n\ndef to_float(text: str | None) -> float | None:\n    try:\n        return float(text) if text not in (None, \"\") else None\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef by_phase(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:\n    phases: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(\n        lambda: {\"turns\": 0, \"five\": [], \"weekly\": [], \"models\": set(), \"providers\": set()}\n    )\n    for row in rows:\n        phase = phases[row.get(\"phase\") or \"unlabelled\"]\n        phase[\"turns\"] += 1\n        phase[\"five\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"five_h_pct\")))\n        phase[\"weekly\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"weekly_pct\")))\n        if row.get(\"model\"):\n            phase[\"models\"].add(row[\"model\"])\n        if row.get(\"provider\"):\n            phase[\"providers\"].add(row[\"provider\"])\n    return phases\n\n\ndef ticket_phases(phases: dict[str, dict]) -> list[str]:\n    return sorted(p for p in phases if p.upper().startswith(\"T\") and p[1:].isdigit())\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ledger\", type=Path, default=LEDGER)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--remaining\", type=int, default=0, help=\"tickets not yet built\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if not args.ledger.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"No ledger at {args.ledger}. Is the Stop hook registered?\")\n    rows = read_rows(args.ledger)\n    if not rows:\n        raise SystemExit(\"Ledger is empty.\")\n    phases = by_phase(rows)\n\n    print(f\"{'phase':<14}{'turns':>6}{'5h spent':>10}{'weekly':>9}  models / provider\")\n    for name, data in sorted(phases.items()):\n        mix = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"models\"])) or \"?\"\n        prov = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"providers\"] - {\"anthropic\"}))\n        print(f\"{name:<14}{data['turns']:>6}{spend(data['five']):>9.1f}%\"\n              f\"{spend(data['weekly']):>8.1f}%  {mix}{(' @' + prov) if prov else ''}\")\n\n    tickets = ticket_phases(phases)\n    if tickets:\n        per = sum(spend(phases[t][\"weekly\"]) for t in tickets) / len(tickets)\n        print(f\"\\nTickets done: {len(tickets)} · average weekly cost per ticket: {per:.1f}%\")\n        last = next((to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) for r in reversed(rows)\n                     if to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) is not None), None)\n        if last is not None and args.remaining:\n            need, headroom = per * args.remaining, 100 - last\n            verdict = \"FITS\" if need <= headroom * 0.8 else \"TIGHT\" if need <= headroom else \"OVER BUDGET\"\n            print(f\"Forecast: {args.remaining} tickets need ~{need:.0f}% of the weekly cap; \"\n                  f\"{headroom:.0f}% remains → {verdict}\")\n            if verdict != \"FITS\":\n                print(\"Fix in this order: 1) lower effort  2) switch to Sonnet/Haiku  \"\n                      \"3) /clear more often  4) split fat tickets  5) Plan B backend (declare it)\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo ticket phases yet. Write the ticket id into .claude/state/phase \"\n              \"at the start of each /implement session.\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":33,"oldLines":7,"newStart":33,"newLines":14,"lines":["     >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])","     3.0","     \"\"\"","-    raise NotImplementedError(\"MP2 Exercise B: implement me with /tdd\")","+    total, previous = 0.0, None","+    for value in series:","+        if value is None:","+            continue","+        if previous is not None and value > previous:","+            total += value - previous","+        previous = value","+    return total"," "," def read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:","     with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ef52c1f8-327e-4f26-b59f-64b485fde240","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

Re-forecast with\n`uv run python scripts/usage_report.py --remaining N` after T01 and after T03.\n\n## Model plan\n\n| Stage | Model | Effort | Estimate (% of a 5-hour window) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `/research`, quick lookups | Haiku 4.5 | low | ~2% each |\n| `/grill-with-docs`, `/to-spec`, `/to-tickets` | Opus 5.5 | xhigh | **actual: 16% for the grill (28 turns), ~2% for spec + tickets** |\n| `/implement` + `/tdd` (per ticket) | Sonnet 5.5 | medium | ~20% per ticket (T03 and T07 likely ~30%) |\n| `/code-review` (per ticket) | Sonnet 5.5 | high | ~5% per ticket |\n| Exercises A and B (`/tdd`) | Opus 5.5 | xhigh | ~2% total |\n\nPlanning ran on Opus 5.5 at xhigh because it was already my default. Sonnet should be cheaper per window, so I expect\n  roughly 3% weekly per ticket, **about 25–30% of one week** for all 8. Weekly\n  was at 4% when this plan was written.\n- **Verdict:** fits, with room for one `stretch` ticket only if the T03\n  re-forecast says FITS.\n\n## If I am wrong, cut in this order\n\n1. Cut T08's visual extras (Cerro de la Silla banner, stadium silhouette) to\n   plain stripes and the disclaimer.\n4. `/clear` more often; split a ticket that crosses 60% context.\n5. Plan B backend (manual Part 9), declared in the README, commit trailers and\n   ledger.\n\nNever cut: `/code-review` on every ticket, the findings comment, and the\n`Closes #N` commits. Re-forecast with\n`uv run python scripts/usage_report.py --remaining N` after T01 and after T03.\n\n## Model plan\n\n| Stage | Model | Effort | Estimate (% of a 5-hour window) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `/research`, quick lookups | Haiku 4.5 | low | ~2% each |\n| `/grill-with-docs`, `/to-spec`, `/to-tickets` | Opus 5.5 | xhigh | **actual: 16% for the grill (28 turns), ~2% for spec + tickets** |\n| `/implement` + `/tdd` (per ticket) | Sonnet 5.5 | medium | ~20% per ticket (T03 and T07 likely ~30%) |\n| `/code-review` (per ticket) | Sonnet 5.5 | high | ~5% per ticket |\n| Exercises A and B (`/tdd`) | Opus 5.5 | xhigh | ~2% total |\n\nPlanning ran on Opus 5.5 at xhigh because it was already my default. That is the\nexpensive end; everything from T01 on switches to Sonnet 5.5 (`/model`, then\n`/effort medium`).\n\n## Forecast\n\n- **Tickets:** 8 core tickets × ~25% (implement + review) ≈ 200% of a window,\n  so **about 2–3 five-hour windows**, assuming I `/clear` between tickets.\n- **Weekly cap:** the grill spent 2% of the weekly cap for 16% of a window\n  (about 1 : 8 on Opus). Sonnet should be cheaper per window, so I expect\n  roughly 3% weekly per ticket, **about 25–30% of one week** for all 8. Weekly\n  was at 4% when this plan was written.\n- **Verdict:** fits, with room for one `stretch` ticket only if the T03\n  re-forecast says FITS.\n\n## If I am wrong, cut in this order\n\n1. Lower effort on `/implement` (medium → low) for the mechanical tickets\n   (T04, T06).\n2. Drop the `stretch` ticket.\n3. Cut T08's visual extras (Cerro de la Silla banner, stadium silhouette) to\n   plain stripes and the disclaimer.\n4. `/clear` more often; split a ticket that crosses 60% context.\n5. Plan B backend (manual Part 9), declared in the README, commit trailers and\n   ledger.\n\nNever cut: `/code-review` on every ticket, the findings comment, and the\n`Closes #N` commits. That's the same identity as your repo's first commit.\n\n**One thing only you can answer:** what's your first and last name? Git and GitHub don't record it, and the transcript files have to use it exactly (`..._first-last_...`).\n\nI need it before you type `/clear`. `/clear` ends this session, and that's the moment the hook saves this grill transcript under whatever name is in `.env`.
